spec.name: References and mood boards
spec.purpose: Sarai researches design references and builds mood boards: every reference lives on a board, carries its source and tags, and can be moved to another board as the concept settles.
layout: PageHeader (Placeholders: add reference, new mood board)
One Card per board with a grid of reference tiles (thumbnail slot, title, source, tags)
Drawer: reference detail, note, move-to-board Select, Placeholder to upload the image
logic: References are grouped by their board field; boards are sorted by name and show their reference count.
Move to board writes references.board through useData (references.manage); the grid re-renders live.
imageUrl is null in every seed row, so each tile shows a labelled empty thumbnail slot with a Placeholder upload control instead of a broken image.

actions.label: Move to board
actions.intent: move the reference {reference} to the board {board}

actions.label: Add reference
actions.intent: add a reference to the board {board}

actions.label: Upload image
actions.intent: upload the image of the reference {reference}
